jobs.name: deps-fix
jobs.prompt: Run the nightly-deps-fix skill unattended, under .claude/rules/nightly.md.
jobs.purpose: Fix red ci-is-enough Dependabot PRs and merge each one that goes green after mechanical changes only.

jobs.name: changelog-driven
jobs.prompt: Run the nightly-changelog-driven skill unattended, under .claude/rules/nightly.md.
jobs.purpose: Move one changelog-driven upgrade (govuk-frontend, or any major) up one version, with an evidence row for every changelog item.

jobs.name: cross-repo-sets
jobs.prompt: Run the nightly-cross-repo-sets skill unattended, under .claude/rules/nightly.md.
jobs.purpose: Move a set that spans repos (Playwright, Node, govuk-frontend) once every member is ready, on one branch name, merging only when every repo is green.

jobs.name: docs
jobs.prompt: Run the nightly-docs skill unattended, under .claude/rules/nightly.md.
jobs.purpose: Bring the docs in line with what merged since the last run, in one PR or none.

jobs.name: digest
jobs.prompt: Run the nightly-digest skill unattended, under .claude/rules/nightly.md.
jobs.purpose: Write the morning digest: open bot PRs, red main builds, sets waiting on readiness, npm outdated drift and what each job did overnight.
